name: dmengine-fumo-download-update
description: Mode C combined FUMO command: the mock sends Exec on ./ManagedObjects/FUMO/DownloadAndUpdate. The lab tree supplies its PkgURL, the engine performs the authenticated DD/DP download, logs DL session complete, sets FUMO update-progressing (state 60) and hands event 77 with /update//lab-fumo to the OEM handler. The engine-side update handoff is asserted; no physical install or update-success is claimed.
